programme_facts.value: ASU Online provides international students a unique opportunity to advance their knowledge and skills by learning from world-class faculty who teach on-campus programs without having to leave their families or careers.

The flexibility of the program in terms of course design, delivery and presentation, along with the immense support from ASU faculty and the Al Ghurair Foundation for Education (AGFE) team, made it all possible.
ASU Online students around the world have access to the same personalized suite of student resources as stateside students, including individualized support from a success coach.
Nearly 11,000 military-affiliated students pursuing their degrees online at ASU.
Support services designed to meet unique needs as an active duty service member, veteran, or military family member.
Military students have taken their classroom to Temporary Duty (TDY) locations in multiple states and deployment in the Indo-Pacific region.

In the past two years, a military student has flown in support of multiple large force exercises, TDY’d three times, deployed twice and PCS’d (permanent change of station) with their family to another country.
A military student has been able to complete their degree with a 4.00 GPA up to this point.
ASU Online delivers a quality online education experience to military members and their families around the world.
A nondegree student takes individual courses without pursuing a full degree program at ASU.
Undergraduate or graduate level
Limited in the number of credit hours you can take a semester
May only apply 12 to 15 credit hours, completed in a nondegree status, to an academic program if you choose to pursue a degree in the future.
Be sure to check your intended program, as there may be some exceptions.
If you’re an admitted ASU Online nondegree student, you’ll earn credit for the courses you take, and they’ll be listed on an official ASU transcript with grades earned.
